meta.restyle: brutalism — token names and component APIs follow the repo; values re-cut from glassmorphism to brutalism at the owner's request

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (repo `--bg`). Raw newsprint in light, flat soot in dark — never a gradient or blob.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, menus and field interiors — replaces the repo's `--glass-bg`. Always sits inside a `border` outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary ink (repo `--text`): body copy, headings, borders and hard shadows. On `bg` and `surface` (17.5:1 light, 16.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, placeholders, helper text, ghost buttons (repo `--text-muted`). On `bg` and `surface` (≥8.2:1 light, ≥6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every outline — cards, fields, buttons, dividers. Same ink as text: brutalism draws edges, it doesn't tint them.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, checked switches, slider range, focus ring, links (repo `--accent`, same blue hue, pushed to full voltage). As text on `bg`: 5.1:1 light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `accent` surfaces (repo `--accent-hover`).

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` / `accent-hover` (5.8:1 light, 7.8:1 dark). Flips to ink in dark because the dark accent is lighter.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Accent badge fill, selected menu row, active nav item. `text` on it (16:1 light, 12.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marker yellow: hover fill of secondary buttons and menu rows, text selection, the one loud stamp per screen. `on-fill` text on it (13.8:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: APPROVE verdicts, healthy connections, success toasts (repo `--color-success` hue 142, as a flat fill). `on-fill` text (11.3:1). Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: COMMENT verdicts, rate-limit and quota warnings (repo hue 85). `on-fill` text (12.8:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: REQUEST_CHANGES verdicts, failed requests, destructive buttons (repo hue 25). `on-fill` text (5.3:1). Lighter-darker gap to `success` keeps them apart without hue.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Queued / processing states, info toasts (repo hue 240). `on-fill` text (10:1).

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Field error messages and the invalid-field border, as text on `bg`/`surface` (5.5:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on every flat fill that stays light in both themes: `highlight`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page hero numbers and the login wordmark. Uppercase, once per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles (Dashboard, Requests, AI Usage, Projects, Settings).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles (repo DialogTitle was 16px semibold — raised for brutal hierarchy).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The bot reviews the change, not the whole repo.
styles.usage: Default UI copy, inputs, buttons, menu items (repo `text-sm`).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, field labels, table headers' emphasis.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, error messages, tooltips, toast descriptions (repo `text-xs`).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, verdict stamps, kicker labels, section eyebrows. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Repo slugs, PR numbers, token counts, costs, SHAs — anything tabular (repo `--font-mono` + tabular-nums).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap (repo `gap-1.5`).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and inline controls (repo `gap-2`).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small button and field horizontal padding (repo `px-3`).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Medium button padding, stack gap between fields (repo `px-4`).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding (repo `p-6`).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, switches (repo 8px → square for brutalism).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts (repo 12px → square).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs (repo 16px → square).

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, zero blur, drawn in ink. They replace the repo's soft `--shadow-glass`.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, pressed buttons, switch and checkbox boxes.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Resting buttons, fields on focus, cards, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and hovered (lifted) cards.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Fields, badges, menu items, dividers, checkbox and switch boxes.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs — the outer edge of anything you can grab.
